Suddenly, half the corporations here were clients of Eidolon Security--and were no longer paying the Hutt Cartel.|[[Gele'ren]], speaking to the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]|<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />}}
'''Eidolon Security''' was a security company and a rival of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. It was founded by the notorious [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], the [[Eidolon (assassin)|Eidolon]], and became a major provider of munitions for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].


==History==
{{Quote|Eidolon Security's got a stockpile of munitions bound for the Republic Army. Crates are at their manufacturing facility in the Corellian Sector. If that facility were to blow up, the Eidolon would owe the Republic billions of credits--which I'm guessing he ain't got just lying around.|[[Gele'ren]]|<ref name="TOR:EB" />}}
[[File:Eidolon2.png|thumb|left|160px|The Eidolon]]
Eidolon Security was created on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by a former [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known only as the [[Eidolon (assassin)|Eidolon]] after he retired from his criminal career. The company was very successful and found soon many clients, including half the client corporations of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on Nar Shaddaa, making the Eidolon an enemy of the Cartel. Its largest client, however, was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which it supplied with billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] worth of armaments per year.
<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the company was significantly damaged by the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], with assistance from [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt]] underboss, [[Gele'ren]] and his [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], [[Anuli]], after its founder was listed as a target of the competition. The hunter sought to draw out the Eidolon by bombing the company's [[Eidolon Armaments|manufacturing facility]] and research center in Nar Shaddaa's [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]].<ref name="TOR:EB" />

{{GameDS}}
[[File:Eidolon Armaments.png|thumb|right|250px|The Eidolon weapons manufacturing facility]]
The hunter succeeded in bombing the company's facilities, killing several engineers, technicians, and scientists in the process.<ref name="TOR:EB" />

The second attack against Eidolon Security would be a leak of its private information, containing a list contracts, shipments, and of clients and their security specs. To acquire and leak this information onto the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], the hunter needed to hack into the company's HoloNet transceivers.<ref name="TOR:CZ">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Catching Zees|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

[[File:Eidolon Security datacenter.png|thumb|left|250px|The Eidolon Security datacenter]]
After acquiring the security codes to Eidolon Security's network from [[Zee K'lin]], a HoloNet security expert, the hunter broke into the [[Eidolon Security datacenter]] in the [[Network Access]] sector, and the hunter's companion, [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] sliced into the company's secure database, transmitting its records to Anuli, who uploaded them onto the HoloNet.<ref name="TOR:IE">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Industrial Espionage|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

The final blow to the company came when the hunter defeated the Eidolon, its founder and head, in combat in his [[Eidolon's safe house|safe house]] and turned him in as a live bounty to the Hutt Cartel.<ref name="TOR:PC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Professional Courtesy|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

Following the defeat of their leader, members of Eidolon Security came to work for the [[Star Cabal]].

==Behind the scenes==
*The player has the option of letting the scientists escape the facility before setting off the bombs, thereby sparing them.<ref name="TOR:EB" />
*The player has the option of giving the Eidolon a mercy killing instead of turning him in to the Hutt Cartel, where a worse fate likely awaits.<ref name="TOR:PC" />
